_doc: Ground truth for the REAL-WORLD corpus (evaluation/fixtures_real): minimal, verbatim, MIT-licensed modules vendored from deliberately-vulnerable training apps (Vulpy, OWASP PyGoat), with per-fixture PROVENANCE.md. This is a RECALL corpus on real framework code (does the tool catch real Flask/Django vulns?), NOT a precision corpus — training apps ship no fixed twins, so false-positive measurement stays with fixtures_hard3/4 plus the one real clean negative here. On a real (noisy) file, findings OUTSIDE the labeled class are 'unlabeled', not automatically false positives; FP is counted only on the safe/ negative. Classes limited to what these apps expose as genuine, user-driven, small self-contained modules (sqli, command_injection via eval, deserialization); SSRF/SSTI/path-traversal in these apps have fixed (non-user) sinks or live in oversized files and are deferred to a future CVE-pair phase.

vulnerable/cmdi_pygoat_eval.note: eval() of request.POST; full noisy Django views module

safe/sqli_vulpy_libposts_parameterized.note: real clean negative: parameterized queries in vulpy's bad/ dir
